title: Meet Chuck Schumer’s (Fake) Senate Campaign Consultant 😉
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Democrats won big in November's midterm elections, and the voters who made
that happen are biting their nails at the prospect of establishment Democrat
Chuck Schumer, 75, becoming Senate majority leader. In an election that
demanded change from its elected officials, Schumer might not be the fighter
you choose, but he's the fighter that ~~Wall Street is most comfortable with~~
you need. Here to further convince you is none other than **Zeteo 's
**favorite Democratic consultant, **Frank Cappello**.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" Chuck's biggest selling point, of course, is his experience," **says
Frank.** "He's been in Congress since 1981, which means he has almost half a
century of learning exactly how the system works, to make sure it never
changes."** And what does he say of Schumer's role in the Democrats' losses in
the 2024 elections when he was majority leader? **" That was Kamala's
fault."**

Watch the full video above to hear the strong case Cappello makes for the
potential Democratic majority leader, including the taglines he is considering
for Schumer's campaign. Our favorite is **" Schumer can't come sooner."
**Share your favorite tagline with us in the comments, and be sure to let us
know if Frank, the fake consultant, convinced any of you to back Schumer for
Senate Majority Leader. 😉
